penalty_per_source.mechanism_repro: penalty-repro.sh x2 (exit 0 both): default variant: baseline valid login ok, 3 failed auths answered 'Permission denied (publickey)', failed auths 4-8 and all 3 subsequent valid logins dropped (exit 255, empty output), sshd log 'srclimit_penalise ... activating ipv4 penalty of 16 seconds for penalty: failed authentication' and 7 'drop connection #0 ... penalty: failed authentication' lines, recovery after ~20s in both runs. Control variant (PerSourcePenalties no): 8/8 failed auths answered normally, 3/3 valid logins ok, 0 penalty lines.
penalty_per_source.smoke_flake_repro: with default PerSourcePenalties injected in ca1/ca2, the 4th injected smoke.sh run (launched immediately after the 3rd) exited 1: FAIL 'ca:p-host1 cert -> host1 accepted' (exit=255, empty output) and FAIL 'ca:broad cert works on BOTH hosts' (host1 exit=255, host2 exit=0); ca1 log has 'drop connection ... penalty: failed authentication'. Rows 6-18 (conflicting config observed manually only; fake agent owned elsewhere; locked provider blocked on a real FIDO2/sk authenticator or interactive native OS lock; Windows/WSL blocked on a native Windows host with WSL2; delayed issuer, stale pipe, response-loss, concurrent environments, runner, management client, local container, Iroh not built) are not verified.

Certificate-expiry-during-session, multiplexing (A23), interrupted mutation, bastion forwarding recipe and managed-credential issuance are not covered.

Fixture sshd sets PerSourcePenalties no, which differs from default OpenSSH 10 behavior; the default behavior is reproduced by penalty-repro.sh and affects retry policy (a dropped connection shows as silent exit 255 at the fixture client LogLevel ERROR).

The original intermittent failure of the first cycle was not retained; its cause is inferred from a later reproduction, not observed in that run. The reproduced flake failed in 1 of 4 injected runs, so absence of failures in the 5 as-shipped runs is not proof of absence of every other flake.

Evidence build binding: build_commit is the parent HEAD 18bb8df but tests/fixtures/ssh/ and MANIFEST.md are untracked (not committed); per-script sha256 digests in artifact_digest identify the exact files run.
The bastion effective-config check was negative-controlled by re-running its assertion logic with an injected override, not by running smoke.sh against a deliberately broken ssh_config.

Key disposal is overwrite+unlink; not a guarantee of erasure on APFS/SSD. Keys are valid only for destroyed containers. Penalty variants copy the fixed host key into runtime/penalty/, removed by down.sh.
